title: WabbleSpec skill-rules.json
description: Activation and authority declaration. One per module. Read at Gate 4 (Activation). No module activates without a valid skill-rules.json (I5).

module.description: Canonical module name. Must match framework.yaml id.

activators.description: Patterns matched against session context, task shape, and request text. At least one required.

anti_activators.description: Patterns that suppress activation even when activators match. Anti_activators take precedence.

file_path_patterns.description: Optional. File glob patterns that trigger activation when matched files are in scope.

build_targets.description: Build targets this module applies to. ["ALL"] = applies regardless of target (I3).

runtime_lanes.description: Vendor-neutral capability descriptors. Never model names (I6). E.g. code-generation, analysis, synthesis, long-context.

stages.description: Spec stages this module activates in (I1).

owns.description: Artifacts this module exclusively produces. No two modules own the same artifact in a session (I11).

reads.description: Artifacts this module consumes but does not own.

verification_mode.description: Required. Verification mode for this module's output (I4). No module omits this.

receipt_required.description: true for all non-trivial modules. Only utility scripts may set false.

collapse_eligible.description: true only when Plan+Execute collapse is supported (I2). Must document conditions in gate_collapsing_conditions.

requires_receipts_from.description: Modules whose receipts must exist before this module executes. Enforced by pre-tool-use hook.
